caption: The drawing depicts a rooster-shaped object, likely a weather vane, mounted on a vertical rod. The rooster is positioned in profile, facing to the left. Its body features a mix of brown, yellow, and olive green tones, with its wing and tail feathers marked by alternating bands of dark gray, rusty red, and mustard yellow. The comb and wattle are colored red, while the beak is a muted brown. The illustration appears to be rendered on a beige or off-white background. The rooster displays layered feather detailing on its wing and body, and the eye is small and black. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature that reads “Densely Chichester.”
title: Weathercock
